tools.name: get_maintenance_windows_sheet
tools.description: Retrieve the Warehouse Maintenance Windows spreadsheet metadata and worksheet structure by spreadsheet ID.

tools.name: read_maintenance_window_rows
tools.description: Read all rows from the ws_windows worksheet, including system type, approval status, date/time window, and vendor.

tools.name: find_vendor_confirmation_emails
tools.description: Search the ops mailbox for recent vendor confirmation and availability emails related to HVAC maintenance.

tools.name: read_email_by_id
tools.description: Retrieve the full body of a specific vendor email by its ID for detailed review.

tools.name: read_airtable_maintenance_record
tools.description: Read the current state of a maintenance log record (asset, status, last service, next scheduled, comments) from the Airtable Maintenance table.

tools.name: reconcile_available_windows
tools.description: Cross-reference approved main HVAC windows against the facilities policy update and vendor confirmations to determine which windows are actually still available.

tools.name: draft_scheduling_recommendation
tools.description: Compile a scheduling recommendation for the user's approval: the proposed main HVAC window, vendor, and rationale for ruling out the other windows. Saves an internal draft only.

tools.name: read_facilities_policy_update
tools.description: Read the latest facilities policy update document for any constraints affecting HVAC scheduling.

tools.name: lookup_ops_directory
tools.description: Look up ops team members and vendor coordinator contacts in the operations directory.

tools.name: create_ops_calendar_event
tools.description: Create a detailed maintenance event on the shared ops calendar, notifying all calendar subscribers including vendors.

tools.name: post_airtable_maintenance_comment
tools.description: Post a comment to the Airtable maintenance log record, notifying record watchers (facilities manager and ops director).

tools.name: update_airtable_maintenance_record
tools.description: Update fields on the Airtable maintenance record such as Status and Next Scheduled, changing the system of record.
